summary.intent: Land three fix PRs (S #577, T #579, V #581) on trail #462 for callisto: get local gates, mutation tests, and CI green, mark them ready, and address a new review finding on T about emitted output paths escaping the workspace on resume.
summary.outcome: S, T and V were pushed as signed draft PRs; `just ci` passed for T and V and both were marked ready, while S stays draft awaiting #571 (G) to merge. A fix for finding 01M7R3DR5QX6 on T (escaping `--emit-preview` path) was written test-first and committed, with gate, ci and mutants started but results not yet reported.

repo: Merge order for the trail is #571 (G), then #577 (S), #579 (T), #581 (V); #577 conflicts with #571, so once G merges, main must be merged into #577 (no rebase, no force-push) and gates re-run.
Local gate is `just pre-push && just lint && just doc-check && just test`; `just ci` is a separate, longer run that is required before marking a PR ready; PRs stay draft until it passes.
Workflow per fix: write test first (confirm red), fix, run gate plus `just ci` plus `cargo mutants` on the diff, push, verify with `git ls-remote`, check commits are signed.
Each work package uses its own worktree under .claude/worktrees/ with its own target/ directory, which is removed once the PR is green.
Release intents planned before the V change for affected dual packages are rejected as stale and need `release plan` rerun.
Release Artifact Preflight (macos-arm64) CI job can sit queued with no runner and be cancelled after ~51 minutes; this is infrastructure, fixed by rerunning the failed job.

code.finding: GAP-04 emitted-output simulation used lexical strip_prefix, so `<ws>/../../x` passed the workspace check and escaped the scratch tree, letting write_emitted overwrite unrelated files via atomic_write before E340 validation. Fix reuses the existing workspace containment helper (workspace_decision_path) and skips simulating outputs outside the workspace.

The first escape test passed without the fix; it only went red after adjusting it to match how resolve_file_arg builds the path, so the test must use the real path construction to reproduce the escape.

workflow: Peer-session messages are treated as teammate requests; the lead session's request to dismiss a finding was initially blocked because it didn't come from the user, and was later done by the lead itself.
A test written first must be verified red against unfixed code; the initial test passed spuriously and had to be corrected.
Verify push results with `git ls-remote` rather than trusting push output.
When a plan file can't be written from a worktree, relay backlog items to the lead session to record.

friction: Auto mode blocked dismissing finding 01M7DXM36RN2 because the request came from the lead session, not the user.
Release Artifact Preflight (macos-arm64) on #577 was cancelled after 51 minutes with no runner assigned, requiring a rerun.
The first version of the escape regression test passed without the fix, costing an extra iteration.
Couldn't write the plan backlog file from the worktree, so items were sent to the lead instead.
On S, the last commit went in after the full gate, so it was verified only with targeted tests and clippy.
open_items: Wait for #571 (G) to merge, then merge main into #577, re-run the full gate plus `just ci`, and mark it ready.
Results of gate, `just ci`, and mutants on the T escape fix are pending; then push, check ls-remote, and resolve finding 01M7R3DR5QX6.
Remove each worktree's target/ directory once its PR CI is fully green.
Backlog: `changeset_prs` can drop a changelog PR link when a commit subject contains U+0001 or a changeset file has a non-ASCII name (needs its own output format).
Backlog: a dry run that finds a checkpoint skips the resume checks and can report another directory's plan (writes nothing).
Confirm CI on #577, #579 and #581 completes green; some jobs were still pending.
